//: Self-contained port of the ICU 'hospitalized human' referenced by MoM's phavian hospital-lab mapgen (place_monster in the beds). DDA/BN's stock mon_civilian_icu lives in a separate Civilians mod we don't depend on, so this flattens that mod's icu->stationary->panic copy-from chain into one standalone def using only BN-base ids (faction human, species HUMAN, harvest human, hflesh). Dropped the chain's fighter cruft that made no sense for a bedridden patient: the 9999-round starting_ammo, PARROT_AT_DANGER (needs speech), the GROUP_NULL upgrade, and the mod's default_civilian_death_drops itemgroup. speed 0 + morale 0 = they just lie there; GUILT so cutting one down weighs on you. Ported 2026-07-14 as part of the hospital-lab re-base; the Civilians mod was the template.
description: This person is severely ill in some form or another, requiring intensive care that is not available anymore after the Cataclysm.  There is nothing you can do for them.
